purpose: Teach: 率いる/解っ/おこなっ/御座い/ことごとく/いたす/こんなにも/みつけ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが少年団を率いる立場になられたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father has taken on the role of leading the boys' group.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Speak as if sharing news that makes you proud of him. Gentle cadence, the voice of a wife noticing her husband stepping up.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの言ってる事が解ってきたよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm starting to understand what Dad says.
lines.style: Bright and earnest. Lean forward slightly with genuine discovery—not showing off, just amazed at the new understanding. Small, natural voice, a child who's been paying attention.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが地域の防災訓練をおこなって下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is conducting disaster-prevention drills for our community.
lines.style: Steady, contemplative tone. Speak with quiet appreciation—noticing the care behind the action. Measured pace, the voice of someone reflecting on how much her husband does.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが「御座います」って丁寧な言葉教えて下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me the polite phrase 'gozaimasu' and I used it.
lines.style: Excited but not loud. Pride in the detail—he's learning a grown-up way of speaking. Slightly faster than before, eager to share what he picked up. The brightness of a six-year-old who feels noticed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが宿題をことごとく確認して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father checked every single one of your homework assignments.
lines.style: Gentle and observant. Speak as if noting a small, thorough kindness—the kind that shows up in the details. Quiet warmth, unhurried, the voice of someone who sees what it means.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「お願いいたす」って言ってみたよ
lines.en: Mom, I tried using 'onegai itasu' with Dad.
lines.style: Lighter than before, almost delighted. A small laugh underneath—proud of himself for trying the formal language. Natural child's pace, the voice of someone learning to speak more carefully and it mattering.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、こんなにもお家を綺麗にして下さってありがたいわね
lines.en: Sho, it's so kind of your father to have cleaned the house so thoroughly for us.
lines.style: Touched and genuine. Warm opening, slight rise on 'so thoroughly' with genuine wonder at the care. The voice of a wife who sees the effort her husband puts in and doesn't take it for granted.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが大事にしてた写真をみつけたよ
lines.en: Mom, I found a photo that Dad really treasured.
lines.style: Hushed, reverent almost. A child who has stumbled onto something precious and is handling it carefully with his words. Slow, gentle delivery, the voice of someone who understands he's found something that matters.
